description: Second real run kept approved wording too literally; added missing qualifiers but remained 1100/1048/1074 characters. Format gate blocked without buying an image.

missingBaseConditions: The base requirement for a crisp palette is omitted.
The requirement that the rear head only, with no visible eyes, nose, mouth, or chest and no shoulder glance, applies in ALL frames is not explicit.
The fourth prevention rule's qualifier that only subtle breathing or normal blinking is allowed is weakened because normal blinking is not stated explicitly.

receipts.prompt: North-facing native pixel dog in every frame, including final hold; north means rear, away from camera. Rear head only in every frame; no visible eyes, nose, mouth or chest; no shoulder glance. Chest breath <=1px; blink optional, with only normal blinking allowed. Fixed head position and unchanged head silhouette, outline, tail, coat markings, paws, coat and eyes; crisp palette and native dog pixel size. Approved pose stable in every frame: no appendage, attached-feature, pose or rear-silhouette displacement or reshaping beyond subtle breathing or blinking; idle visually still, with no repeated appendage movement, wag cycle or bob. Keep seed tail shape and position fixed; hidden tail stays hidden; never add a tail above the head or ears, crown or antenna. Hidden front tail stays behind body; side/rear tails stay complete and connected in the approved pose. Fixed camera; no props or text. Use the entire transparent 40x40 canvas; every frame has two clear pixels at every edge, all paws and tail complete. No cropping, shrinking, blur or detached parts. Loop smoothly to the initial pose.
